perf_note: d1_fast = the D1 base cell (m2_first_cell_rwkv7.json) + the GPU-gated step fixes (job-2amiy, jobs/perf_step_gate rule perf_step_gate v1; stack/rwkv7/perf-step @953f3ac): row_plan min_cost 6.58 s/step (1.20x), + cont_plan single 6.11 (1.29x, peak 63 GB), + compile_blocks 5.63 (1.40x, peak 63 GB) vs greedy 7.89 on the same box. Loss within 1.9e-4 relative; gradient cosine 0.998 for every variant incl. pure regrouping, i.e. the GPU reduction-order floor (Agent A overrode the 0.999 bar on that evidence). Execution-only: not in the TrainConfig hash. Everything else, caps included, is D1; the same 190-min clock trains ~40 % more rows (time cap binds). Template for future cells.
execution_note: job-tvuat (jobs/cell_step_profile, rule v1-A2, PR #86 @54ee89d) ADOPT: chosen ckpt_rows_lean = per-block activation checkpointing keeping the cache fork, the step's 8 rows batched in length-sorted groups (<= 8 rows, <= 8,192 padded tokens per call; long rows split a step into several groups), chunked_lean WKV (our pure-PyTorch rearrangement of the vendored chunked WKV, CPU-equivalence-tested; no GPU gate needed); measured median step 8.25 s, 0 OOMs, projection 1,382 steps / 11,056 rows in 190 min (receipt receipts/2026-10-07-D-cell-step-profile-tvuat). Execution flags are not in the TrainConfig hash (same loss and gradients). rwkv7_wkv applies to both arms (child: run_cell / m2_gates; parent: score_parent). 'fla' only after jobs/fla_rwkv7 ADOPT + GPU_VERIFIED.
max_minutes_note: D16's 380-min clock and max_steps 4,500 unchanged (data is the only variable vs D16). Cell phase = D16's 455 - 32 (tokenize delta for 100k rows) + 85 (tokenize delta for 227,946 rows at D1's 10 min / 24k: 10 x 227.946/24 = 95.0 -> 95, +85 vs D1's 10) = 508, + 9 for the whole-set guard scans in train.train_set.draw (CPU 2026-10-09: 528 s on 227,946 rows) = 517 (job_params). ~4,050 steps / ~32k rows at the d1_fast step (5.63 s), ~3,000 steps / ~24k rows at ~7.5 s (v3w, K > 16 rows): ~11-14 % of the 227,946-record pool. A 412-min clock (cell 549, schedule 899) is the largest inside the 899-min ceiling. D16's note follows. D10 SCALED clock: 2x the 190 = 380 min ~= 4,050 steps / ~32.4k rows at the d1_fast step (5.63 s, job-2amiy); max_steps 4,500 (D7 kept 3,000, which would bind at ~282 min = 24,000 rows with the fast flags) so the time cap binds; ~32 % of the 100k draw. K > 16 rows cost more fork work per row (unmeasured), so fewer rows if steps are slower (v2f mean T 838.7 vs d1_fast's 604.5: ~7.3-7.8 s/step -> ~3,000 steps / ~24k rows) (at D1's 8.25 s: ~2,763 steps / 22.1k rows). Cell phase = D7 d7_t380's 421 (380 + tokenize 10 + smoke/ladder 10 + dev cards 10 + checkpoints/margin 11) + 2 more checkpoint margin (~10 ckpts at 400) + 32 more tokenize for 100k rows (10 x 100/24 = 41.7 -> 42) = 455. Cumulative over restarts (train_clock in cell.json)
min_steps_note: exit 26 if the measured step time cannot reach 600 optimiser steps (4,800 rows) inside max_minutes: below that the cell is not a meaningful first measurement; re-price instead of spending the evals
lora_rank_note: M2_RUN_SPEC r=256 adds ~1.15B trainable params (~18 GB of fp32 weights + grads + Adam) on top of 26.5 GB bf16 weights and the un-checkpointed cache-fork activations; r=64 (the pilot's pre-registered rank) keeps the T=2048 ladder rung inside the 76 GB stop
train_max_k_note: D8 code (#221 on agent-main): K cap of the training items only (train.run_cell.train_max_k; cell_items default, also used by the m2_gates lineage rebuild); max_k 16 remains the eval cap (train.m2_gates.unit_spec, run_cell eval_items). B1 100k-v2 carries rows with > 16 options (BANKING77 77-option catalogs, Glaive catalog views K 17-27), which max_k 16 alone would drop.
row_options_note: execution guard (train.trainer.row_groups / single_cont_fits): <= 160 forked continuations per backbone call; a row with K > 160 runs alone, and a step whose summed K exceeds 160 runs per group under cont_plan single. Worst call = 8,192 prefix tokens + 160 copies ~= 53.8 GB (tvuat ladder 1,024 rung) + 80 x <= 87 MB ~= 61 GB < 76 GB stop (D8 sizing). Not in the TrainConfig hash; never binds on K <= 16 steps (8 x 16 = 128).
format_note: readout-format swap point (coordinator 2026-10-08): template / layout (and r1_format_commit) are the ONLY keys that select the format; data, flags, caps and job_params are format-independent. v3w swap = once B's d3_v3w_fast code (training renderer for jrt-rwkv-g1-v3w in heads.layout / train.data, score_parent's G1V3Backend(mode='words') parent branch, decide_backend identity, check_g1v2_train_equivalence --template v3w) is merged into this branch, set template jrt-rwkv-g1-v3w (layout as B's d3_v3w_fast) in both D10 cell JSONs, re-run the census (T > 2,048 share, items by K) and the train==readout check, re-package; caps unchanged unless the census shows rows materially longer.
anti_collapse_note: train/trainer.py TrainConfig anti-collapse fields; each absent key = the old behaviour. lr_schedule and collapse_* are in the config hash; with collapse_guard on, dev_card_every/rows/seed are too (they set the accuracy-trigger timing and the rollback target); best_ckpt is operational. Each dev card scores a 200-row hash-stratified sample over every cohort-dev source (dev_card_seed; ids + sha256 in cell.json dev_card_sample; G12 reports paired.dev_remainder without them). Budget it inside max_minutes.
